parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle Low German grēve, ultimately from Proto-West Germanic *garāfijō.

parole.significato: lance (weapon of war, consisting of a long shaft or handle and a steel blade or head; a spear carried by horsemen)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle Low German spētze, from Old Saxon spiot, from Proto-West Germanic *speut (“spear”).

parole.significato: game (activity described by a set of rules, especially for the purpose of entertainment)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle Low German spel, from Proto-West Germanic *spil. Doublet of pila.
